title: Decode only the alpha plane of a transparent image when color is already cached

definition.title: Decode only the alpha plane of a transparent image when color is already cached
definition.source_excerpt: For a format/profile with independently stored transparency, preserve cached color and decode only changed alpha for a requested mask/composition view. Verify exact RGBA and reject entropy-coupled formats.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
